blocks.text: A quick heads-up on the calendar. Our email and file systems will be down for a short maintenance window over the coming weekend, and the mailbox may be slow or unavailable for a few hours while the work is done. Nothing needs to move on anyone's part; it is routine upkeep, and everything should be back to normal by Monday morning.

Daniel Valenzuela is coordinating the window with our vendor, so if you have something time-sensitive that weekend, send it his way and he will make sure it is covered. Otherwise, please plan to be off the system for that stretch.
